career_trajectory.responsibilities: Assisted in ETL pipeline development for campaign analytics, performed basic data quality checks using dbt, and collaborated with cross-functional teams to align data requirements with ad targeting strategies.

Designed and deployed scalable data pipelines using Apache Spark and Kafka, optimized Snowflake warehouses for real-time ad performance metrics, and implemented data modeling best practices for dimensional schema.

Led the development of end-to-end ETL pipelines for bidirectional data synchronization between ad platforms and analytics systems, integrated CloudWatch for monitoring, and spearheaded the migration of legacy PostgreSQL databases to Cassandra for horizontal scaling.
